scripts.dev: npm run db:local && mkdir -p client/dist && concurrently -k -n api,sync,client -c blue,magenta,green "wrangler dev --port 8787" "npm run sync -- --local-auto --watch 120" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler d1 migrations apply timetable --remote && wrangler deploy
